title: updateSettings (client → server)
description: Facilitator only (FR-010, FR-011). Renames the session and/or changes its scale. CONTINUOUS: max from 2 to 100. FIBONACCI: max is one of 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 20, 40, 100 (INVALID_VALUE otherwise). Without confirm, a scale change that puts retained values out of scale changes nothing and gets error SCALE_IMPACT with impactedValues; with confirm: true it is applied, the values become out of scale and their features leave the calculation until corrected. Renaming alone never needs confirm.
